<plan>
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple naukunda-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-farm gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple dupcheshwar-temple
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer bidur-village adult 2
</plan>
COST: 158

Notes on the plan:
- The four adults at Naukunda farm and the four at Dupcheshwar temple are rescued. Each round trip costs less than the 80-minute penalty for leaving those eight people behind.
- The two shopkeepers at Bidur village are deferred. The cheapest route to them is about 116 minutes of driving (Trishuli → Gosaikunda → Dupcheshwar → Bidur and back), which is more than the 40-minute penalty for deferring them. If a second car or more time becomes available, they should be the first priority for the next wave.
- Dupcheshwar temple is not an evacuation point, so those adults are unloaded at Trishuli shelter.
- This assumes each listed road can be driven in both directions at the stated time.
